content:
name: EOSR WP-MVP-0003 Closure Bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosr/close-wp-mvp-0003-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  EOS_ACTOR: chatgpt

jobs:
  close:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Enter exact accepted-review baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="d80cb125c92dd80b07317e96acde1a568258a880"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          git reset --hard "$BASE_SHA"
          test ! -e .github/workflows/eosr-close-wp-mvp-0003-bootstrap.yml
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Prove pre-closure review state
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv
          wp=Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0003.md').read_text()
          assert '**Status:** IN_REVIEW' in wp
          assert wp.count('- [ ] ') == 7, wp
          review=Path('engineering/reviews/WP-MVP-0003-REVIEW.md').read_text()
          assert '**Decision:** ACCEPTED' in review
          rows={r['id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('.eos/work-packets.tsv'), delimiter='\t')}
          assert rows['WP-MVP-0003']['status']=='IN_REVIEW'
          PY

      - name: Reconcile accepted criteria and refresh evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          path=Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0003.md')
          text=path.read_text()
          expected=[
            'US-008 stable Source IDs are equal across equivalent clean clones.',
            'US-009 SHA-256/source/parser provenance is recorded and changes when consumed bytes change.',
            'US-010 duplicate governed identifiers produce collision diagnostics naming all sources.',
            'content edits do not change Source ID solely because content changed.',
            'explicit governed Document IDs survive source-path moves; path-only Source IDs do not.',
            'absolute host path, time, random IDs, inode/device data, and Git branch do not affect identity.',
            'case-collision and symlink-alias fixtures are deterministic.',
          ]
          for criterion in expected:
            old=f'- [ ] {criterion}'
            new=f'- [x] {criterion}'
            assert text.count(old)==1, (criterion, text.count(old))
            text=text.replace(old,new)
          assert '- [ ] ' not in text
          assert text.count('- [x] ') == 7
          path.write_text(text)
          PY

          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0002 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0004
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0003 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0005
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv
          wp=Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0003.md').read_text()
          assert '**Status:** IN_REVIEW' in wp
          assert wp.count('- [x] ') == 7
          assert '- [ ] ' not in wp
          rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('.eos/evidence.tsv'), delimiter='\t'))
          current=[r for r in rows if r['target']=='WP-MVP-0003' and r['status']!='SUPERSEDED']
          assert len(current)==3, current
          assert all(r['execution']=='EXEC-0005' and r['status']=='VALIDATED' for r in current), current
          assert next(r for r in current if r['validator']=='eos-integrity')['result']=='PASSED'
          assert next(r for r in current if r['validator']=='repository')['result'] in {'PASSED','SKIPPED'}
          assert next(r for r in current if r['validator']=='execution-acceptance')['result']=='PASSED'
          PY

      - name: Require WP_CLOSE gate and close packet
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos gate explain WP_CLOSE WP-MVP-0003
          ./scripts/eos close WP-MVP-0003 \
            --reason 'Human-authorized governed closure following accepted EOSR review merged through PR #206 and complete verified acceptance criteria.'
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv, json
          wp=Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0003.md').read_text()
          assert '**Status:** CLOSED' in wp
          assert wp.count('- [x] ') == 7
          rows={r['id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('.eos/work-packets.tsv'), delimiter='\t')}
          assert rows['WP-MVP-0003']['status']=='CLOSED'
          state=json.loads(Path('.eos/state/current.json').read_text())
          assert state['entities']['WP']['WP-MVP-0001']['lifecycle_state']=='CLOSED'
          assert state['entities']['WP']['WP-MVP-0002']['lifecycle_state']=='CLOSED'
          assert state['entities']['WP']['WP-MVP-0003']['lifecycle_state']=='CLOSED'
          assert state['entities']['WC']['WC-MVP-0001']['lifecycle_state']=='ACTIVE'
          PY

      - name: Commit closure and prove post-commit stability
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          FINAL_BRANCH="eosr/close-wp-mvp-0003"
          git config user.name 'ChatGPT'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add -A
          if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '^(Cargo|crates/|src/|.*\.rs$|tools/eos/|product/|architecture/|specifications/|engineering/work-cycles/|engineering/increments/|engineering/maintenance/|\.github/workflows/)'; then
            echo 'Unexpected product/governing change in WP closure.' >&2; exit 1
          fi
          git commit -m 'chore(eosr): close WP-MVP-0003'
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "d80cb125c92dd80b07317e96acde1a568258a880"
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$FINAL_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Final closure branch exists' >&2; exit 1; fi
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$FINAL_BRANCH"
